summary.en-US: Local-first research and writing workspace with structured sources, citations, native XML documents, and direct PDF export.

version.approval_notes: Timeless is a local-first Firefox desktop extension with no browsing or host permissions and no data collection. The Firefox edition uses the same React/TypeScript application source as the desktop/web build, but intentionally omits automatic source metadata lookup because the desktop implementation depends on a bundled loopback-only Node/Zotero translation service that is not shipped in the Firefox extension. Manual source entry, Evidence notes, CSL citations/references, native XML save/open, IndexedDB recovery, and client-side PDF export remain available. A reproducible source archive is uploaded with this submission; see MOZILLA_REVIEWER_BUILD.md for build instructions and validator-warning explanations. The packaged extension was smoke-tested on Firefox 156.0.1 with XML round-trip and PDF export checks.
